name: Brighton Rock
desc: A stick of pink-and-white boiled sugar with BRIGHTON running all the way through it. Restores 130 HP and loosens most fillings.

name: Sussex Pond Pudding
desc: A suet pudding steamed round a whole lemon, so it sits in a 'pond' of buttery lemon sauce when you cut it. Restores 160 HP.

name: Gypsy Tart
desc: Kent's school-dinner legend: evaporated milk and dark muscovado sugar whipped into a sticky caramel filling. Restores 145 HP.

name: Kentish Hops
desc: Papery green cones dried in a Kentish oast. They smell of beer and summer, and a pillow stuffed with them is meant to help you sleep.

name: Canterbury Ampulla
desc: A little lead flask like the ones pilgrims wore home from Becket's shrine, filled with 'Canterbury water'.

name: Mod Target Badge
desc: The red, white and blue RAF roundel, borrowed by the mods of the sixties for their parkas and scooters.
effect_text: Starts every battle with Speed raised.
msg: {name} is off the line first, thanks to its Mod Target Badge!

name: Bluebird Brooch
desc: A Dover keepsake with an enamel bluebird, after the wartime song. There are no bluebirds in Britain, but there are a great many brooches.
msg: {name}'s Bluebird Brooch kept the storm off!
